title: US-018 Cap the crew size a planner can assign
description: Marco adds a crew capacity cap to the assignment flow, with the field and the permission it needs. He also takes Total Capacity kW off the Installation layout to make room, which nothing checks and somebody should notice.
commitMessage:
US-018 Cap the crew size a planner can assign

Adds Crew_Capacity_Cap__c on Installation and a decision in Installation_Assign_Crew
that brings an over-sized crew back down to the cap. Granted on Helios_Delivery_Manager.
Moved the cap onto the Installation layout.
prTitle: US-018 Cap the crew size a planner can assign
prBody:
Planners have been assigning crews larger than the installation can take, and the crews end up
in each other's way on small roofs.

This adds `Crew_Capacity_Cap__c` on Installation, and a decision in `Installation_Assign_Crew`
that brings the crew back down to the cap when a planner goes over it.

- New field `Installation__c.Crew_Capacity_Cap__c`
- `Installation_Assign_Crew`: new `Crew Over Cap` decision after the status assignment
- `Helios_Delivery_Manager`: read and edit on the new field
- Installation layout: the cap added

Story: US-018 in BACKLOG.md
